Rafael Gomez: Hey everyone! I'm Rafael, just started today (backend infra). Remote from Málaga, Spain. Big plant nerd and sticker collector :seedling: :sparkles:
Priya Nair: Welcome Rafael!! :wave: We're doing an informal plant/cycle swap next Friday at 4pm in the SF office — bring cuttings if you wanna trade.
Rafael Gomez: Ooh love that. I'm remote but I can mail cuttings. Any good envelope tips? :postal_horn:
Jules: Welcome! If you're into stickers I made a small 'sticker stash' box in the common area. Label things if you wanna reserve.
Devon Lee: Badge is ready — @Sam Tran can confirm for on-site folks. Also FYI kitchen coffee is espresso-only on Tuesdays ☕️
Sam Tran: Yep badge set for Rafael's profile (if/when you come in). Also +1 on the sticker box. Bring something nerdy.
Maya Chen: @Rafael if you ever do a plant mail, wrap in wet paper towel + ziplock. Works like a charm.
hr-bot: Welcome, Rafael! Onboarding checklist: https://redwood.example/onboarding/rafael — hours, benefits, payroll. Ping peopleops with questions.
dev-bot: New hire announcement posted to #all-hands. :tada:
Rafael Gomez: Thanks all! Quick question — is there a buddy program? Would love someone to grab virtual coffee with next week.
Priya Nair: I can do virtual coffee Tue 10am PST. I'll DM calendar invite. :coffee:
